title: Deuxième partie : variations sur l'équation des lacets [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois…, pages 293 à 650, dont table des matières] : notes et copies de notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page continues the construction of auxiliary profinite groups attached to a pair (ρ,σ) in the 'variations sur l'équation des lacets' setting. Judging from the NB on the previous page, which mentions SL(2,Ẑ) and 'modular' ρ,σ, these are presumably finite-order elements whose centralizer data enter a loop equation. The ingredients are:
- a quotient group γ_{ρ,σ} (written Γ_{ρ,σ} in places);
- surjective homomorphisms onto it: δ_ρ: Z_ρ→γ, δ_σ: Z_σ→γ, δ_G: G_{ρ,σ}→γ, and δ_B: B_{ρ,σ}→γ;
- B_{ρ,σ}, an extension of γ by L_0 = Ker δ_B.

Grothendieck defines two iterated fibre products of groups over γ_{ρ,σ}:
(49) S_0M^0_{ρ,σ} = {(u,a,b,U) ∈ B×Z_ρ×Z_σ×G : δ_B(u)=δ_ρ(a)=δ_σ(b)=δ_G(U)} = B ×_γ Z_ρ ×_γ Z_σ ×_γ G. This is a subgroup of S_0T^0 × G, where S_0T^0 = B×_γ Z_ρ×_γ Z_σ is the group of (37)/(40) on the previous page.
(50) M^0_{ρ,σ} = Z_ρ ×_γ Z_σ ×_γ G, i.e. triples (a,b,U) with equal images in γ.

Forgetting u gives (51) S_0M^0 → M^0. Its kernel is {(u,1,1,1) : δ_B(u)=1}, which is L_0. Surjectivity holds because δ_B is surjective (lift the common image). This yields the exact sequence (52): 1→L_0→S_0M^0→M^0→1.

The projections give (53) Θ_G: M^0→G, Θ_ρ: M^0→Z_ρ and Θ_σ: M^0→Z_σ. Composing with (51) gives the same maps on S_0M^0, and there is an extra projection (54) Θ_B: S_0M^0→B.

The next page then identifies S_0M^0 ≅ M^0 ×_γ B as the pullback of the extension B by L_0. It also computes the kernels of the maps to γ: SZ_ρ×SZ_σ×(kernel of δ_G), plus a factor L_0 for S_0M^0. The whole construction is bookkeeping that sets up the groups acting on, or parametrizing, solutions of the loop equation, in parallel with §48 IX for SL(2,Ẑ).
errors: No mathematical error. Exactness on the right in (52) tacitly uses that δ_B is surjective (B is an extension of γ by L_0, so this holds).

Notation drifts: (49) has superscript 0* on the left side while (51), (52) and (54) use S M^0; the ambient space is written ST^0 where the previous page wrote SΓ^0; the base group is called Γ_{ρ,σ} in the braces but γ_{ρ,σ} on the previous page.

ideas.what: Iterated fibre product of groups over a common quotient γ_{ρ,σ}, used to build the groups M^0_{ρ,σ} and S_0M^0_{ρ,σ}
ideas.modern_name: fibre product (pullback) of groups / subdirect product

ideas.what: Exact sequence 1→L_0→S_0M^0→M^0→1 obtained by pulling back the extension B of γ by L_0 along M^0→γ

deep.surprise_reason: Routine group-theoretic bookkeeping (fibre products and a pulled-back extension). It is an intermediate step in Grothendieck's unpublished study of the loop equation and contains no standalone new result.
transcription_corrections: In (49) and (50), 'ℤ_ρ, ℤ_σ' should be the groups Z_ρ, Z_σ (centralizer-type groups), not p-adic integers.
In (50) the ambient product is (by (56) on the next page) Z_ρ×Z_σ×G_{ρ,σ}; the handwritten letters that look like 'T_ρ, T_σ' should be read as Z_ρ, Z_σ.
In (49) the left side is written S_0M^{0*}_{ρ,σ} (subscript 0, superscript 0*), and the ambient group is S_0T^0_{ρ,σ}.
The braces read 'relations dans γ_{ρ,σ}' (the quotient group of the previous page), with 'cf (17)'.
The page number at bottom is 511; the header 559 is Grothendieck's own numbering.
